title: skill-contract intake-item/v1 payload
description: The predicate.payload of an intake-item/v1 envelope written by ops-intake's intake.py pick. Every string that came from a source (title, url, evidence) is untrusted data.

item_id.description: The queue item id: I + the first 10 hex of sha256(source NUL source_id).

source.description: The configured source name, or release.

source_id.description: The issue key, the CI workflow/job/branch, or the release version.

url.description: Untrusted; empty when the source has none.

trust.description: low for intake-signals-jsonl, whose provenance is only what the user's transform claims.

count.description: Distinct evidence seen for the item.

evidence.description: Quoted, untrusted evidence, newest last, at most 20 entries.
